text: Three family trusts. One pledge. Here is what Symbiotec Pharmalab's promoter family disclosed on the twenty fifth of September.
On the ninth of September, three promoter family trusts pledged their shares to Beacon Trusteeship, the debenture trustee, as security for debentures.
Add it up. Two blocks of twenty one point nine nine lakh shares, plus three point five lakh. That is forty seven point four eight lakh shares, or seven point three eight percent of the company.
It is all in the trustee's own disclosure to the stock exchange.
A pledge is security. If the debentures are not repaid, the trustee can enforce the pledge on these shares.
And one line in the deal matters. The promoter group must keep at least twenty six percent.
Educational research, not investment advice. Moat and Margin is not SEBI registered. Every number here is from the company's own filing.
